notes.title: Hatsune Miku VR Oculus Quest launch celebrated with massive prize giveaway!
notes.content:
The Oculus Quest 2 standalone VR headset hits shelves today, and right alongside it, we've got a brand new Quest version of Hatsune Miku VR (compatible with the old Oculus Quest as well as the new Oculus Quest 2), available to purchase for digital download RIGHT NOW.

And to celebrate this new launch, we've decided to give away $1,500+ worth of Miku goodies. All you've gotta do to enter is help spread the word!

Find out more (like how to enter, and what all the prizes are) at our official website here:

[url=http://promo.degicagames.com/vr?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=crosspromo&utm_campaign=launch ]Hatsune Miku VR Official [/url]

If you still haven't met Miku in VR, this may be your chance, as it's never been easier or more affordable!

Feel free to enter our giveaway campaign, and you might even win one to play around with! Or one of 15 other prizes, many of which are rare and/or out-of-print.

Just be sure you don't drag your feet too long, as the giveaway campaign ends October 26th! So you've got just two weeks to secure your spot in our drawing...

notes.title: Hatsune Miku VR v 2.01: Bug fix
notes.content:
Happy new year !

A quick update for the bug that was preventing the perfect clear animation to show up.

Also, due to popular demand, v1.1 has now been made available on beta.
You can select it by opening the steam game property and selecting v1.1 in the beta tab. Please be aware that version 1.1 is "as is" and will not change anymore. To return to the most recent version, just select "default" on the beta tab.

Cheers and happy dancing.

notes.title: Hatsune Miku VR v2.0: Major gameplay update
notes.content:
Today we're happy to bring you a big update to Hatsune Miku VR:

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[b]- Gameplay Update[/b]
Notes will now come closer to you, letting you pick them up in front of you instead of having to extend your arms to the sides, to better accommodate different players and hardware.

[b]- 8 Speakers[/b]
Four new speakers have been added as sources of notes, making for more variation. And in hard modes the speakers start to move...

[b]- Sound Effect ON/OFF option[/b]
Due to popular demand, there is now an option letting you turn off the sound when you pick up or miss a note.

[b]- Updated Menu[/b]
Improved menu legibility by using a larger font.

Due to these changes, the leaderboards have also been reset.
